repo: (any Rust repository the operator opts in)
note: Opt-in per project (projects[].manifest includes 'hermetic-tests'). The one lane here runs the repository's own test suite, so it executes repository code: it belongs only on repositories the operator owns and has declared.

checks.description: The repository's cargo test suite, run the way a bare CI runner sees it: an empty HOME (every cache the code consults starts empty), debug info off, a target folder of its own, after the preparation steps the operator declared in the registry (projects[].hermeticTest.prepare). A developer's own cargo test inherits the developer's caches: on 2026-09-27 veld's suite passed locally while the runner failed 216 tests for want of a model this machine already held. Also reports what the build occupies against a hosted runner's free disk (CW_RUNNER_DISK_GB, default 14).
checks.remediationPrompt: You are remediating hermetic test findings from test-hermetic.json (findings[] with rule, path, sev, test, detail; path is the test binary's source file). Per rule: test-failed — the test failed with an empty HOME, debug info off and the operator's declared prepare steps; the detail carries its panic message. A test that passes on a developer machine but fails here usually depends on something that machine has and a runner does not: a model or cache under HOME, a tool on PATH, a file outside the repository, the network. Fix the dependency: make the test create what it needs in a temporary directory, or, where the dependency is genuine, ask the operator to add a prepare step to the registry. Do not skip or #[ignore] the test to clear the finding. build-failed — the suite did not compile; fix the compiler error. prepare-failed — a declared prepare step exited non-zero; the detail carries its last output. disk-headroom — the test build is close to a hosted runner's free disk; build tests without debug info (CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0), or free space in the job before building.
checks.formatNotes: test-hermetic.json is the in-house rule-counts shape: {tool:'test-hermetic', summary:{findings, byRule, filesScanned, testsRun, cargoExit, passed, failed, ignored, binaries, targetBytes, runnerDiskGb, prepareSteps, declaredBy, void, voidReason?}, findings:[{rule, path, sev, test?, step?, detail}]}. Rules: test-failed (path = the test binary's source, e.g. tests/handler_tests.rs; identity is (rule, path, test), never line), build-failed, prepare-failed, disk-headroom. Counts are summed over every test binary. EGRESS: registry — crates.io for cargo, plus whatever the operator's declared prepare steps fetch (veld: huggingface.co and github.com releases, pinned and SHA-256 verified by its own downloader).
